expected_findings.behavior: The shared dispatcher now contains a legacy-event special case instead of routing event policy through the handler registry.
expected_findings.impact: Each future event-specific exception must edit the canonical dispatch path, increasing coupling and making the dispatcher harder to reason about and test.
evidence: The head adds a legacy branch before the handler lookup and imports a feature-specific handler into the shared dispatcher.
The existing handler registry already provides the extension point for event-specific behavior.
